name: presentation-skill
description: Source-first PowerPoint/PPTX generation for Codex and ChatGPT agents.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable PowerPoint decks with model-adaptive style routing and QA.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight source-first PowerPoint/PPTX workflow for coding agents. One capable model can author and refine a deck, with optional questions and style previews. Deterministic scripts preserve editable charts and tables, check readability, and expose focused repairs. Verified render caching speeds unchanged rebuilds without reusing visual approval.
defaultPrompt: Turn this CSV into a lab-style PPTX report.
Redesign this deck and run slide QA.
